title: Verify job apply routes
description: Verify LinkedIn job rows, recover exact company apply URLs, and block expired, mismatched, or unproven routes.

datasetId.title: Source job dataset
datasetId.description: Read job rows directly from another Actor's dataset (any LinkedIn or job scraper). Common field names are detected automatically, no mapping needed. Leave empty when pasting rows below.
datasetId.sectionDescription: Choose a dataset or paste rows. The prefill is ready to run.

rows.title: Paste job rows instead
rows.description: Paste job rows as JSON. Each row needs a LinkedIn job URL or ID plus title, company, and location. An existing applyUrl or company website is treated as a hint and re-verified, never trusted blindly.

prefill.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer, Copilot Agent Platform

maxItems.title: Maximum jobs to verify
maxItems.description: Maximum jobs to process, up to 500. Start with 10 for a quick check; large batches and deep searches take longer. API calls without this setting can process all supplied rows up to 500.

autoDiscoverCompanyWebsite.title: Discover official company websites
autoDiscoverCompanyWebsite.description: Recommended on. Discovers the employer's official website from public evidence when the row lacks one; without it, unknown companies cannot be resolved to exact ATS routes and are held as AMBIGUOUS (free) instead of guessed.
autoDiscoverCompanyWebsite.sectionDescription: The defaults favor accuracy and refuse unsafe guesses.

useReaderFallback.title: Use public page reader fallback
useReaderFallback.description: Recommended on. Uses a second public read path when the direct LinkedIn page is unavailable, recovering rows that would otherwise be held as AMBIGUOUS. No LinkedIn login or cookies are used either way.

maxSearchQueries.title: Maximum search queries per unresolved job
maxSearchQueries.description: Upper bound on public search queries per row. Higher values improve recall on cold companies at the cost of run time; the default suits recurring feeds where most employers repeat.
maxSearchQueries.sectionDescription: Change these only when a difficult source needs deeper discovery.

maxCandidates.title: Maximum candidate pages to prove
maxCandidates.description: Upper bound on candidate pages fetched per row. Every candidate must pass the full verification policy before it can become an output route; raising this raises recall and run time, never the risk of an unproven URL.

maxBridgePages.title: Maximum job mirrors to inspect
maxBridgePages.description: Upper bound on job-mirror pages consulted per row. Mirrors may reveal an official outbound URL to verify, but a mirror itself can never become the published route.

includeVerificationReport.title: Generate batch verification report
includeVerificationReport.description: Optional. Writes JSON, HTML and text verification reports to the run key-value store. Currently included at no additional event charge; OUTPUT.verificationReport records billing status.
includeVerificationReport.sectionDescription: A forwardable summary of the batch, built from the delivered rows.
